title: Zero-to-Live Activation Manifest
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, operational-first manifest to take a product from last staging signoff to Live (GA). It’s deliberately pragmatic: clear owners, discrete acceptance signals, stepwise traffic plan, and explicit rollback/mitigation triggers. Use as the single source during the final 14 days and the first 7 days after GA.

Scope:
- Applies to hosted API + Dedicated launches. Private deployments should re-run the checklist with customer-specific networking/KMS steps.
- Focused on technical readiness, operations, KPIs and run-of-show; pricing/marketing go-to-market items live in MarkOps tracker.

Key contacts (mission control):
- Launch lead: Priya Nair (product-ops) — final gate decisions
- SRE on-call: Ethan Park — infra incidents and rollback execution
- Serving runtime lead: Sofia Alvarez — performance regressions, kernel fallbacks
- Solutions engineering: Jun Wei — customer preflight checks and docs
- Pager escalation path: SRE -> Head of SRE -> CTO (if SLOs breached > 60 minutes)

Readiness rubric (must pass all three categories to declare GA):
1) Safety & Reliability (SRE signoff) — p95 latency within target, error budget <= 10% consumed in prior 72h, automated rollback validated
2) Quality & Regression (ML/Product signoff) — sample prompts pass regression suite (no >5% decrease in key intents), hallucination rate below agreed threshold for critical intents
3) Operational Playbooks (Product-ops signoff) — runbook for degradations, incident roles defined, customer-facing status page templated

Core KPIs (baseline vs target) — measure every 24h during rollout
- API p95 latency: baseline 220ms -> target <= 250ms under canary load
- Error rate (5xx + client-visible failures): baseline 0.06% -> target <= 0.15% during ramp
- Cost per 1K tokens (hosted): baseline $0.75 -> target <= $0.90 (accept short-term spike in canary)
- Activation conversion (invite->first-API-call): baseline 45% -> target >= 60% for GA cohort
- Eval pass rate (regression prompt set): baseline 92% -> target >= 90% (no single intent < 85%)
- Mean time to recovery (MTTR) for alerted incidents: baseline 28m -> target <= 30m

Prelaunch (D-14 to D-3) checklist — owners and status notes:
- D-14: Canary plan approved by SRE + infra capacity reserved (Owner: Ethan Park) — TODO: confirm Dedicated GPU pool size (reserved 6x A100 equiv)
- D-12: Regression eval run and issues triaged (Owner: Sofia Alvarez) — Blocker: tokenization edge-case for user prompts (JIRA ML-203)
- D-10: Instrumentation hooks live: per-route traces, request-id propagation, token-level cost metrics (Owner: Jun Wei)
- D-8: Runbook drafted and reviewed by SRE + product-ops (Owner: Priya Nair) — includes escalation matrix and rollback play
- D-7: Customer communication templates + status page draft (Owner: Solutions Eng)

Canary & Ramp plan (traffic shaping):
Phase 0 — Internal smoke (0%): internal teams and synthetic load. Validate end-to-end, KV cache warm, continuous batching behaviour. Duration: 6 hours.
Phase 1 — Canary (0.5% traffic slice or 10 rps whichever smaller): monitor latency p95, qps stability, error rate, tail latencies. Duration: 6–12 hours with minimum 2 business cycles.
Phase 2 — Slow ramp (1% -> 10% over 24 hours): increase traffic in 2x steps every 2 hours if KPIs stable. Abort criteria: error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10 minutes or p95 > 2x baseline for 15 minutes.
Phase 3 — Wide ramp (10% -> 50% over 48 hours): start marketing soft-open and onboard early accounts. Keep autoscaling headroom configured + failover route to smaller model variant.
Phase 4 — GA (50% -> 100% over 1–3 days): open to all invited accounts, monitor cost and quality signals closely.

Rollback & mitigation triggers (explicit):
- Immediate rollback to previous model version if regression eval fails on canary > 3 critical prompts (Owner: Sofia Alvarez)
- Route-level rollback (send route to CPU fallback or cheaper quantized variant) if p95 latency tripled for >15m (Owner: Ethan Park)
- Pause on public rollout if customer-facing incident > 1 hour affecting > 10% of requests (Owner: Priya Nair)

Monitoring & dashboards (minimum set):
- Per-route latency p50/p95/p99 + token-level cost (Console dashboard)
- Error budget burn chart with 1h/6h/24h windows
- Regression eval pass rate over time (ML dashboard)
- Request sampling sink (3% of traffic) to S3 for manual quality checks

Final acceptance test (playbook):
1) 2-hour steady-state canary with no critical alerts + p95 within target
2) Synthetic workload with peak QPS for 1x expected real-world peak to validate autoscaling
3) Sample customer data end-to-end (with consent) processed and validated by Solutions Eng
4) Billing and metering test: tokens billed correctly in test accounts

Known risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Cold-start tails on complex prompts -> Mitigation: pre-warm common prefixes, enable KV cache retention for canary buckets
- Risk: Regression in hallucination for new tokenizer path -> Mitigation: hold new tokenization behind feature flag and A/B test on internal accounts
- Risk: Unexpected cost spike -> Mitigation: preset cost ceiling alert + automated throttling to cheaper model variant

Post-launch (Day 0 -> Day 7) playbook:
- Day 0 immediate: 2-hour post-GA checklist call (all stakeholders) — review canary logs, errors, customer feedback
- Day 1: Full metric sweep and top-10 incidents triage (SRE/Serving/Metrics)
- Day 3: Quality review with ML team: deep dives into sample failures and hallucinations
- Day 7: Launch retrospective, update runbooks, and handover to steady-state oncall

Acceptance criteria for closing the manifest (for product-ops to mark done):
- All checklist items completed and documented in ticket PRODOPS-412
- No outstanding Sev2+ incidents older than 48 hours
- KPIs stable within target windows for 72 hours after GA (or documented mitigation plan for a single KPI)
- Post-launch action items triaged with owners and ETA

Open questions (for leadership):
- Should Dedicated customers be given VIP warm lanes (yes/partial)? Need headcount for SE warm handovers.
- Tolerance for short-term cost overruns during ramp (ceilings and billing credits)?

Notes to reviewers:
- This manifest is intentionally concise. Add granular checklists (security, legal, marketplace) as attachments if needed — link them in linked_artifacts.
- If any owner changes, update this document and tag the oncall rotation in the runbook channel (slack: #launch-mission-control).

Quick links/shortcuts referenced above:
- Regression ticket: JIRA ML-203
- Mission control channel: slack://channels/launch-mission-control
- Infra PR for autoscale knobs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/578

End of manifest.
